narratives.headline: Nine-game Friday, five props, all unders: Battle and Randle lead a Consider-grade board while injury reports are still open
narratives.briefing: It is a full nine-game Friday with nothing tipping before 2026-11-21T00:00Z, and the report's edge is again concentrated in player unders rather than game lines. Jamison Battle Under 3.5 rebounds (conviction 55) and Julius Randle Under 10.5 reb+ast (conviction 52) are the strongest cards, with the simulation landing under in 74% and 72% of runs; none of tonight's five props clears Consider, and Jalen Smith grades as a Pass. The morning report is 6-4-0 (+1.50u) with closing lines moving toward our morning picks 8 times and against 2, which is the more encouraging signal, but game lines are 13-30 (-18.41u) since 2026-11-11, so the five unders and the CLE spread below are leans only. This edition goes out before final injury reports: we are waiting on Cade Cunningham (probable), Trey Murphy III and Alperen Sengun (questionable), plus De'Andre Hunter and Andrew Nembhard. Any change there re-prices the affected cards on the next run.

If the price runs past −111 or the line drops to 2.5, pass.

What makes this wrong is minutes: his overs averaged 35.3 minutes and he is projected for 27.9, so a heavier load than expected is the main threat. We found no fresh injury or rest news on him this morning.

The case against is real: OKC is #6 softest of 30 for small-forward rebounds, he averaged 10.0 rebounds in 2 games against them, and only 4 of his last 10 went under. Trey Murphy III is listed day-to-day with a knee issue after missing Wednesday, and his status is a kill trigger for this card.

The worry is the spot: he is 1 of 6 under against ATL, ATL games have +4% rebounds available, and Grayson Allen being out adds +1.9 minutes. Treat this as the most fragile of the Consider cards.
